backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md core multi-window protocol plus Space frozen snapshots

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies; the helper remains default-off metadata and live Space slots stay zero.

attention_overlay_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least one attention-only event seed and at least one official non-attention event seed

government_contract_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with government_space_contract from an official non-attention source

multi_event_depth.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least two official, non-attention event seed rows

single_event_defense_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with exactly one official non-attention seed, government_space_contract present, no customer_win, and defense_budget_theme

gate_questions.q1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: add a small incremental scalar only to Space trend_long signals with source-diverse, multi-event official catalyst profiles.
q2_prior_experiments: exp-20260514-009 accepted forward same-theme replacement-strength trend risk.
exp-20260514-026 accepted company-source trend interaction but was narrow RKLB-only.
No prior record found for a source-diversity trend-only interaction on top of exp-026.
gate_questions.q3_single_causal_variable: Only the additional source-diversity trend risk scalar changes; accepted exp-026 stack and all entries/exits/ranking/targets stay fixed.
gate_questions.q4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least two EV-improved windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown damage <= 0.5pp, survival >= 5%, >=50 aggregate trades, and real adjusted signals.

hypothesis: Space source-diverse, multi-event official catalyst evidence should be most useful when the market setup is trend continuation rather than a generic event flag. On top of accepted exp-20260514-026, a single extra source-diversity trend scalar tests that semantic quality interaction without adding tickers, filters, lifecycle rules, LLM authority, or live Space slots.
known_risks: The Space sleeve remains default-off and historical Space snapshots are frozen research copies.
Source-diverse current event profiles are used as replay metadata and should not imply live slots.
The experiment is a sizing helper only; it does not prove a standalone Space sleeve can trade live.
next_evidence_needed: Promote only as shared default-off Space metadata/helper; keep live Space slots at zero until forward replacement evidence broadens.

locked_variables: accepted forward replacement stack through exp-026
all prior accepted Space risk helpers

single_causal_variable: extra risk scalar for official Space trend_long signals whose production event seed profile has both source diversity and semantic catalyst-bucket diversity
why_not_other_changes: The multi-closed forward consistency idea maps mainly to LUNR, but LUNR has no executed Space trades in the fixed replay windows. VSAT, IRDM, 5d confirmation, benchmark-laggard, peer-leader trend, and breakout haircut branches already failed recent gates. This keeps the candidate pool fixed and tests a broader production-visible semantic quality interaction.
